name: Stimgraph
one_liner: Maps X bookmarks as a globe of saved posts, people, topics, and the links between them.
how_to_ingest: Read this JSON first. Watch public/demo/stimgraph-silent.mp4 with the matching beats[]. The video is silent; captions and this file carry the meaning.

what_it_shows.topic: Lime diamond. A named theme on saved posts.
what_it_shows.person: Filled dot. Bookmark author, or an account you follow.
what_it_shows.following: Quieter person with no saved posts yet.
what_it_shows.scout: Cyan diamond. A suggested post, not a bookmark.
what_it_shows.affinity_link: Dotted line. Overlap across saves. Does not change ranking.

views.label: Neighborhood
views.does: Nodes within N steps of the selection.

views.label: Combine
views.does: Your graph plus an imported .stimgraph neighborhood.

live_behavior.connect: OAuth read-only: bookmark.read, follows.read, tweet.read, users.read, offline.access. No write scopes.
live_behavior.sync: Pulls up to 600 bookmarks plus following. Streams pages as X returns them.
live_behavior.poll: Visible live tab polls the newest 15 bookmarks every 90 seconds. X has no bookmark webhook here.
live_behavior.enrich: Optional. Sends the next 40 bookmark texts and author handles to xAI. Never sends the X token. store: false.
live_behavior.scout: Optional. Searches X with x_search using top topics, frequent authors, and followed accounts. Optional 12-minute repeat while the tab stays open.

share_format.bridge_nodes: Matching people/topics in both graphs are highlighted.

beats.say: Stimgraph maps X bookmarks as a globe of topics, people, and saved posts. STIM means Stuff That Interests Me.
Drag to spin. Scroll to zoom. Hover to read names. Click a node to focus it.
The inspector shows why the node is here and the nodes one link away.
Press / or click search. Jump to a person, topic, post, or command.
Topics are lime diamonds. Click a row to fly the camera there.
Cyan diamonds are Grok suggestions from X, not bookmarks.
Grow a two-step neighborhood from the focus node. Export it as a .stimgraph file with no bookmark text.
Import another neighborhood. Matching people and topics become highlighted bridges.
Density, weakest visible link, motion, overlap links, labels, and color palettes. Saved on this device.
Same lime and cyan meaning on paper. Light and dark share one token set.
Connect X is read-only. Sync, Grok topic names, and scout are separate clicks.
